clue.text: A county cricket club holds record: beat Spain, getting favourable reaction

indicators.note: the club 'holds' the next pieces, so they sit inside its letters

parts.note: CCC is the standard abbreviation for County Cricket Club
an EP is an extended-play record
to tan someone's hide is to beat them
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A cricket club sets a record and beats Spain, and the crowd loves it.
explanation.walkthrough: The club abbreviation CCC opens after its second C to take EP and TAN, giving CCEPTANC; A goes in front and E (Spain) at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Acceptance is a favourable response, as when an offer or idea is welcomed.

clue.text: Whispered comment dismissing second political adviser

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so the letter for second is taken out

parts.note: an aside is a remark made in a low voice, as on stage

explanation.surface: A political adviser murmurs a remark while a deputy is sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is an assistant to a minister or official, a political adviser.

clue.text: Overcome argument against short question

parts.note: a con is a point against, as in pros and cons

indicators.note: short means the word for question loses its final letter

parts.note: a query is a question

explanation.surface: Someone defeats a counterargument with a brief question.
explanation.definitionFit: To conquer is to defeat or get the better of, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Adjusted pro rata invoice knocking off one zero causes quibbling

indicators.note: adjusted signals the letters of the invoice phrase are rearranged
knocking off means taking away, here one of the letters for zero

parts.note: a zero is the letter O

explanation.surface: Fiddling a proportional bill by dropping a nought leads to arguments.
explanation.walkthrough: Take one O from PRO RATA INVOICE and rearrange the remaining thirteen letters. 'causes' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevarication is evasive talk or hair-splitting to avoid the truth, which is quibbling.

clue.text: Shorter able-bodied man serving on game point, about given up

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
RU is rugby union

indicators.note: in a down clue, given up means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A sailor plays a game and concedes a point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given up' reverses RE to ER at the foot of the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrupter is a comparative of abrupt, meaning more curt or brief, so shorter.

clue.text: Typical vegetarians keeping produce young

indicators.note: the words keep the answer inside them, spanning the two words

explanation.surface: Ordinary vegetarians keep farm animals that bear young.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows and other large animals calve when they give birth.

clue.text: A military force backed at a distance

indicators.note: backed means going backwards, so the force's letters are read in reverse

parts.note: the RAF is the Royal Air Force

explanation.surface: An air force supports something from far away.
explanation.definitionFit: Afar means far off or at a great distance.

clue.text: Loud rave, sick at heart and agitated

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
to rave and to rant both mean to speak wildly

indicators.note: at heart means the central letters of the word sick are used

explanation.surface: A noisy party leaves someone ill and anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Frantic means wildly agitated with worry or haste.

clue.text: Houses team in new centres with no end of cost

indicators.note: the team word goes inside the reworked letters
new signals the letters of centres are made into a fresh arrangement
with no means a letter is removed from centres
end of means the last letter of the word cost

parts.note: a side is a team

explanation.surface: Houses a team in new centres, saving on costs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of' drops the final letter of 'cost', and 'new' reshuffles what is left of the word centres so it wraps around the team.
explanation.definitionFit: A residence is a house or home, so residences are houses.

clue.text: Steps idiot takes in answer for university

indicators.note: takes in means the idiot word receives a new letter
for means in place of, swapping one letter for another

parts.note: a dunce is a slow learner, an idiot

explanation.surface: A fool gets an answer in place of a university place.
explanation.definitionFit: A dance is a set series of steps, as in learning the steps.

clue.text: Takes part in training loyal reps at work

indicators.note: at work means the letters are being worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Faithful sales representatives do practice sessions at the office.
explanation.definitionFit: Role-playing is acting out scenarios, often as an exercise in staff training.

clue.text: Government action, as it develops in hardship

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters inside the word for hardship

parts.note: privation is lack of necessities, hardship

indicators.note: develops signals the letters change shape into a new order

explanation.surface: A government policy develops amid hardship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develops' turns AS IT into ISAT, which goes inside PRIVATION after PRIVAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Privatisation is a state policy of selling public industries to private owners.

clue.text: Unprotected fund grew in value without recognition

indicators.note: unprotected means losing its outer guards, so only the inner letters of fund remain

parts.note: to appreciate is to rise in value

explanation.surface: An unprotected fund grew in value without anyone noticing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unappreciated means one's worth goes unrecognised or unthanked.

clue.text: Supporter has time and gives help on the radio for make-up people

parts.note: a fan is a supporter

indicators.note: on the radio means as spoken in broadcast, signalling a sound-alike

parts.note: to assist is to give help

explanation.surface: A fan with a spare moment helps out at a radio station's make-up department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make-up' looks like cosmetics; it means people who make things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Fantasists invent stories and imagine things, so they make things up.

clue.text: Broadcast source of malicious lies about old rewards scheme

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of malicious
about signals the letters of lies are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: A broadcast spreading malicious lies about a former loyalty scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: AIR MILES was a British loyalty scheme collecting points for flights, since rebranded.
explanation.definitionFit: Air Miles was a loyalty programme giving points toward flights, now discontinued.

clue.text: May is able to dance

parts.note: may, giving permission, can mean can
can means is able to

explanation.surface: In May, someone is able to dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May' looks like the month but it is the verb of permission.
explanation.definitionFit: The cancan is a lively high-kicking French music-hall dance.

clue.text: Misshapen toes here, and this may be in Oxford

indicators.note: misshapen means bent out of form, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Deformed toes are found here, inside an Oxford.
explanation.walkthrough: An Oxford is a style of lace-up shoe, not the city.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden form kept inside a shoe such as an Oxford to hold its shape.

clue.text: Family court proceedings admitting bishop

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the bishop's letter goes inside

parts.note: a trial is a court hearing
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A family court case lets a bishop in.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribal describes a tribe or clan, a kinship group, used adjectivally as in family ties.

clue.text: One complete fabrication about son's hero-worship

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
to do a task is to complete it

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the fabrication goes round the son

parts.note: a lie is a fabrication

explanation.surface: A totally made-up story about a son's adoration of a hero.
explanation.definitionFit: To idolise is to adore someone uncritically, as fans worship a hero.

clue.text: Quiet ones steal such mushrooms

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
two Roman numeral ones, I and I
to take is to steal

explanation.surface: The silent ones pinch those mushrooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiitake is an edible East Asian mushroom species, here used as a plural.

clue.text: Chains of soldiers holding deer up

indicators.note: holding means containing the next piece

parts.note: soldier ants are a caste of ant, so ants can be soldiers

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: an elk is a large deer

explanation.surface: Chains of soldiers hold up a deer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down light 'up' turns the deer backwards; soldier ants are a real caste of ant, so 'soldiers' can be ants.
explanation.definitionFit: Anklets are ornamental chains or bands worn around the ankle.

clue.text: Guess how film noir may have been produced?

definitions.meaning: a wild attempt with no information to go on

definitions.text: how film noir may have been produced?
definitions.meaning: film noir is a dark style, so it might be filmed literally in darkness

explanation.surface: A mere guess, or a joke about shooting moody thrillers.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a random guess; literally, a shot taken with no light.

clue.text: Ridiculously crossing borders for key capital

indicators.note: crossing means going across and around the next piece

parts.note: too means excessively, ridiculously so

indicators.note: the borders of key are its outer letters

explanation.surface: Absurdly, crossing borders is key for a capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Tokyo is the capital city of Japan.

clue.text: Set fund using odds for stallion

indicators.note: using odds means taking the odd-numbered letters, first, third and so on

explanation.surface: Establishing a fund on the betting odds for a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a stallion kept for breeding.

clue.text: Sail with a king taken in by fisherman's lure

indicators.note: taken in by means placed inside the lure word

parts.note: a spinner is a revolving fishing lure
K is the chess notation for king

explanation.surface: A sailing king is fooled by an angler's bait.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinnaker is a large balloon-shaped sail set at the front of a yacht.

clue.text: Still at home — ends in strife after breakfast

parts.note: being in means at home

indicators.note: ends in means the last letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Still at home, as strife ends after breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means motionless and not acting, so still.

clue.text: Fat solidified across middle of cup

indicators.note: across means stretching over, so the solidified word straddles the next piece

parts.note: jelly that has set has solidified

indicators.note: middle of means the central letter of cup

explanation.surface: Fat has solidified across the middle of a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Suet is hard animal fat used in British cooking for puddings and pastry.

clue.text: Brought up to date, way diners must change

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner

indicators.note: must change signals the letters of diners are rearranged

explanation.surface: Diners must change their ways now the restaurant has modernised.
explanation.definitionFit: To modernise is to update something to current standards.
